name: CRITICAL FIREWALL
description: Under no condition may any record enter learning_dataset if learning_eligibility = blocked, audit_tag != none, validation_failed = true, or normalization_applied = true and learning_eligibility was auto-set to blocked.

name: DUPLICATE CONTROL
description: If the same decision_id + event_type already exists, status = duplicate_blocked, dataset_inclusion = false, storage_targets = ["audit_log"], and trust_level = none.
